Subject: Kickoff: closure milestone coordination & exec sponsor map

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, to keep the Q4 timeline tight we'd like to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and an Exec Briefing (EB) date this week so procurement and your execs have clear milestones. Two asks from our side:

1) Can you confirm the executive sponsor(s) you want engaged for the EB (title + preferred attendee)?
2) Which company-owned procurement contact should we loop in for final T&Cs?

I attached a draft MAP that maps milestones -> owners -> dependencies. Proposed EB windows (all PT): Nov 2 AM, Nov 4 PM, Nov 9 AM. If you prefer a different cadence we can adapt.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx (draft MAP)

Next step: once you confirm sponsors and preferred slots we’ll circulate a final attendee roster + short pre-brief runbook (30-40m).

Best,
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191

Ben —

Appreciate the draft. Quick answers:

- Executive sponsors available: Tom Mercer (CEO) and Priya Shah (CIO). Tom prefers morning slots; Priya can do afternoons.
- Procurement contact: Dan Lee (dan.lee@procureit.com) — copying him now.

We reviewed the MAP at a glance and it looks good; procurement will need a week to review contract language once we receive redlines.

Given the constraints, can you propose a single EB time that accommodates Tom (morning) and Priya (we can rotate if needed)? If not, we’ll need two shorter sessions.

Thanks —
